whatItIs: openssh-portable is an open-source project in the post-quantum cryptography category. It is maintained by open-quantum-safe and primarily looks like a C codebase. Fork of OpenSSH that includes prototype quantum-resistant key exchange and authentication in SSH based on liboqs.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches post-quantum cryptography workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: Please read https://www.openssh.com/report.html for bug reporting instructions and note that we do not use Github for bug reporting. This is the port of OpenBSD's excellent OpenSSH[0] to Linux and other Unices.
whoItsFor: Security-minded developers and teams looking for practical quantum-safe cryptography resources they can evaluate today.
